content: Rahul Jain called to check the status of his health policy (SH-123456). Insurance agent Sunita Agarwal informed him that the policy is currently expired due to a payment processing issue, despite Rahul claiming he paid premiums on time. Sunita apologized and escalated the issue to the payments team for further investigation.

action_items: Escalate the issue to the payments team to investigate the payment processing error
